newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda Demio orders exceed target.
newsitem.headline: Mazda Demio orders exceed target.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp received about 7,000 domestic orders for its new Demio compact station wagon in the first seven days after its launch, a Mazda spokesman said on Tuesday.
Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, introduced the Demio on August 26 in Japan with a monthly sales target of 4,000 units, and 5,000 in the initial period.
In late August, Mazda said it would operate its Ujina No.1 plant in Hiroshima, western Japan, for an extra two days in September to raise production of the Demio.
